about_page.heroSubtitle: A company built on trust, cultural expertise and passion for Franco-Vietnamese trade.
about_page.founderBio: Franco-Vietnamese, Anna grew up between two cultures. After studying international business, she founded CNL Sourcing to help French companies access the Vietnamese market with confidence.
about_page.storyP1: CNL Sourcing was born from a simple observation: too many French companies give up sourcing in Vietnam due to lack of reliable local contacts, language skills or regulatory knowledge.
about_page.storyP2: Thanks to her family and professional network in Vietnam, Anna offers a turnkey service, from supplier research to delivery in France — with full transparency at every step.
